title: Telemetry tour: vignette slate pack for observability onboarding
creator: Tessa Nguyen
description: Create a compact ‘vignette slate’ asset pack used in the onboarding telemetry tour. These assets will be used in the quickstart flow, docs, and in-product banners to introduce latency, cost-per-token, and trace views. The pack emphasizes short, skimmable frames (vignettes) rather than full-page walkthroughs so we can reuse them in emails, docs, and a carousel in the Console introduction pane.
deliverables: 6 annotated single-frame screenshots: latency overview, P50/P95 traces, cost-per-token sparkline, call-level trace waterfall, KV cache hit-rate vignette, rollout fallback trace
2 mobile-adapted crops for the top three frames
1 Figma component set with tokenized copy and redlines for dev handoff
Export-ready PNGs (2x and 3x) and SVG where appropriate
A short alt-text and copy pack for docs and i18n handoff (EN, FR, DE)
acceptance_criteria: All 6 frames match the Console color tokens and pass 4.5:1 contrast for text over background
Annotations are consistent with product terminology and approved by PM
Assets exported with correct 2x/3x sizes and filenames; dev-ready Figma link shared
Engineering sign-off on data masking for screenshots and on trace fidelity (ENG-40211)
design_notes: Prioritize compact visual density: each vignette must communicate the single-most action a user should take (eg. investigate latency spike, toggle cache)
Use consistent microcopy for metrics (P50/P95, avg token cost). Avoid duplicating full chart legends to keep thumbnails legible
Trade-off: simplified trace waterfall with collapsed spans to keep thumbnails readable. Full trace exists in Console link
Prefer vector-rendered sparks for token-cost charts; rasterize traces where anti-aliasing artifacts appear
